questions.label: Uptime target
questions.ask: What monthly uptime do you commit to?
options: No uptime commitment, response time only
questions.fills: Cover: Target Uptime (delete the uptime part if none). Order Date, Framework Terms parties and Customer use the clickthrough model: Customer is the company or person who accepts this agreement and the effective date is the date Customer first accepts (clickthrough model); the Framework Terms are the Key Terms included below. Fees, Subscription Period, Payment Process, Auto-renewal, Technical Support, Support Channel and General Cap Amount come from the terms interview.

questions.label: Uptime credits
questions.ask: If uptime falls short, what credit does the customer get?
options: 10% of the monthly fee below target, 25% below 99.0%, 50% below 95.0%

questions.label: Scheduled downtime
questions.ask: When may you take the service down for maintenance without it counting?
options: During a weekly window, e.g. Sunday 00:00-04:00 UTC

questions.label: Response time
questions.ask: How fast do you commit to respond to a support request?
questions.fills: Cover: Target Response Time (delete that part if none)

questions.label: Response credit
questions.ask: What credit applies each time you miss the response time?

questions.label: Price increases
questions.ask: Can the price go up at renewal?
questions.fills: Cover: Cloud Service Fees increase options

questions.label: Higher-cap claims
questions.ask: Which claims get a higher liability cap than the general one?
options: None; the general cap covers everything

questions.label: Higher cap
questions.ask: How high is that higher cap?
options: 2x fees paid in the prior 12 months
3x fees paid in the prior 12 months

questions.label: Uncapped claims
questions.ask: Which claims have no liability cap at all?
options: Privacy or confidentiality breaches from gross negligence or willful misconduct

questions.label: Security commitment
questions.ask: What security commitment goes in the contract?
options: Comply with our published security policy

questions.label: Insurance
questions.ask: Which insurance do you promise to carry?
options: General liability, E&O and cyber, $1M each

questions.label: Optional sections
questions.ask: Which of these apply to your contracts?
options: A free trial or pilot before the paid period
questions.fills: Cover: Pilot, Professional Services and DPA rows. Rows not selected are deleted, as are Use Limitations, Additional Warranties and Other Changes unless the founder names one.
questions.follow_up: For a trial ask its length and whether it is free; for services ask what is included and how it is billed.
